newsitem.title: USA: IMF seen voicing support for Asian nation - sources.
newsitem.headline: IMF seen voicing support for Asian nation - sources.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund is expected to issue a statement of support for an Asian country on Thursday, international monetary sources said.
Speculation centers on the Philippines, whose currency has been under attack after the financial crisis in Thailand.
The sources, who declined to be named, said the IMF was expected to issue the statement at about 9:00 p.m. (0100 GMT).
Manila has raised interest rates sharply in recent days and intervened heavily in the foreign exchange market to protect the peso.
IMF First Deputy Managing Director Stanley Fischer told reporters on Tuesday that the Philippines had handled the fall-out from the Thai crisis "very well."
But the peso has dropped further since then, amid rumors that Manila will be forced into a devaluation.
